text: Morning weighs the night: the bazaar opened with all ten stalls standing and the graveyard empty. The roster is plain — Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock all present at the match’s first dawn — and no night has yet passed to shutter any. Herald, confirm the roster and graveyard, then the square may move on.
